# Sarthak Agrawal

> Personal site of Sarthak Agrawal — AI infrastructure and product engineer. Portfolio, shipped products, and technical writing.

Built on Astro, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.

## Machine-readable corpus

- [Agent catalog](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/api/ai): JSON inventory of every public page and its Markdown counterpart
- [Full public corpus](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/llms-full.txt): Combined identity, portfolio, case-study, résumé, and writing content
- [Homepage Markdown](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/index.md): Canonical identity and selected work without JavaScript

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/): Hero, selected work, and contact
- [Projects](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/projects): Full project archive; the landing page leads with three products plus SaaS Maker
- [About](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/about): Background, stack, and availability
- [Résumé](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/resume): On-site résumé and PDF download
- [Writing](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/blog): Devlog and technical posts
- [Privacy](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Fleet performance without Argo](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/blog/fleet-performance-without-argo): Case study on closing desktop LCP p75 under 500 ms across Cloudflare sites
- [Attention Is All You Need. Twice.](https://sarthakagrawal.dev/blog/attention-is-all-you-need-twice): LLMs as the production engine, marketing as the distribution engine

## Product fleet

### Spotlight

- [CodeVetter](https://codevetter.com): Desktop-first AI code review for agent-generated diffs
- [PostTrainLLM](https://posttrainllm.com): Post-training and small-language-model learning workspace
- [HeyPace](https://heypace.app): Local-only macOS voice agent
- [SaaS Maker](https://sassmaker.com): Directory and operating layer for the full product fleet

### Full directory

- The broader project archive is maintained at [SaaS Maker](https://sassmaker.com)
